experiment.name: queue_based_initial_state_1800
experiment.title: Sensitivity to initial queues, 1800 s
experiment.description: Matched arrivals and unseen seeds 1101–1130 compare the empty initial state with five initial vehicles per approach. No warm-up is removed; queue samples support a separate full-horizon versus post-300-s transient sensitivity summary.
